considerations: Map vendor-specific action values before using the threshold.
Exclude approved scanners and confirm that targets are part of your intended perimeter.
description: Find bursts of firewall denies across many ports on one destination.

evidence.claim: Microsoft reported Storm-3358 using ARTEX around financial-sector intrusions, including fast network probing, password abuse and infrastructure associated with remote access tooling.

expected_output: One row per source, destination and five-minute window.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Find bursts of firewall denies across many ports on one destination.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Rapid Denied Probes Against a Single Network Edge

1.json:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceAction in~ ("deny", "denied", "drop", "dropped", "block", "blocked")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP) and DestinationPort > 0
| summarize Denies = count(), Ports = dcount(DestinationPort), SamplePorts = make_set(DestinationPort, 20) by SourceIP, DestinationIP, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Denies >= 40 and Ports >= 12
| order by Ports desc, Denies desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
